A '''torpedo-like boarding pod''' was used by an [[unidentified TIE variant]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. These projectiles were similar in design to the [[Escape Pod Deluxe]] and were used to send [[Terror Trooper]]s to breach the hull of the [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']] in a [[battle near the Itani Nebula]].
